title: Opt in to Codex observations
scenario: Scenario: native-observation / workflow-map. 2026-10-18. A committed source, Python 3.11+, Codex and an explicitly authorized disposable project are required. Collection is off by default. Native trust and model access are separate prerequisites.

steps.title: Choose one client and review trust
steps.instruction: Open the map: Anytime > Self-improvement and eval > 1. Observe. Follow the native guide to create one exact-project Codex grant and preview its installer registration. Review the four observer definitions in native /hooks before activation; existing planning trust is separate.
steps.caption: Actual current map dialog. Follow its source guide for the authoritative commands and limits.
steps.expected: One selected client receives observation delivery. Default installations collect nothing; preview and discovery alone do not prove callbacks executed.

steps.title: Check actual callback evidence
steps.instruction: In an authorized disposable session, exercise a synthetic read/write and an intentional failure. Inspect native records and planning context separately. Retain exact runtime identity and counts; then revoke the grant and remove owned test delivery.
steps.caption: Browser-rendered results from a historical macOS Codex 0.163.0 / GPT-6-Luna fixture, before the later process-directory guard; not a terminal screenshot.
steps.expected: All four kinds occurred in this fixture. Codex tool-end status remains unknown even after a nonzero shell result. Revoked no-op was checked through a direct dispatcher, not another native model turn. The later guard requires both process and payload directories to match the granted root and has separate focused and installed-dispatcher checks.

steps.title: Keep platform blockers visible
steps.instruction: Before relying on another host, compare its evidence with the native guide matrix. Treat observed callbacks, usable tools and authenticated model behavior as separate checks. Preserve a blocked result instead of weakening sandbox or authentication boundaries.
steps.caption: Browser rendering of actual Linux results: Codex callbacks/planning passed but tools were blocked; Claude proves initialization/SessionStart only.
steps.expected: A partial Linux result does not qualify the complete fixture. Without usable Claude authentication, a model run was not attempted. No WSL, parent lineage, complete delivery or model-effectiveness claim follows.
